chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Shaybani told us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi told me, saying: Sahl ibn Ziyad told us, saying: Ahmad ibn Bashir al-Barqi told me, from Yahya ibn al-Muthanna, saying: Muhammad ibn Abi Talha al-Sayrafi told us, saying: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) say: I heard my father narrate, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them),

that the Messenger of Allah (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family) said to the people: Beware of the green of waste (khudra' al-daman). It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and what is the green of waste? He said: A beautiful woman from a bad place of emergence (lineage/environment).

key_terms.خُضْرَاءُ الدَّمَنِ: The green of waste; a metaphor for a beautiful woman from a humble or bad background
key_terms.مَنْبَتِ سُوءٍ: Bad place of emergence; referring to lineage, family, or environment

ai.seo_question: What does 'khudra' al-daman' (the green of waste) refer to in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from the Ahl al-Bayt, interpreting 'khudra al-daman' (green of waste) as a metaphor for a woman whose external beauty ('greenery') conceals internal flaws or inferior lineage ('waste'). This concept underscores the Shia emphasis on *nasab* (lineage) and *khuluq* (character), suggesting that marital compatibility requires evaluating both aesthetic appeal and spiritual/social pedigree to ensure harmony.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ahmad al-Shaybani, that he said: I was told by Muhammed bin Abi Abdillah al-Kufi, that he said: We were told by Sahl bin Ziyad, that he said: I was told by Ahmad bin Bashir al-Barqi, from Yahya bin Muthanna, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi Talha al-Sayrafi, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both, say: I heard my father tell from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon them,

that the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said to the people: Beware from the green that is from waste. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and what is the green that is from waste? He said: A beautiful woman from a bad place of emergence.
